name: wingman
description: A desktop AI overlay copilot — sees your screen, hears your meetings, stays hidden from screen shares. Bring your own AI key.

scripts.build: electron-builder --dir && codesign --force --sign "Apple Development: cherrybaddam1981@gmail.com (M5H8PKHJ7X)" --entitlements build-resources/entitlements.mac.plist --deep dist/mac-arm64/wingman.app
scripts.install-app: npm run build && osascript -e 'tell application "wingman" to quit' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -rf /Applications/wingman.app && cp -R dist/mac-arm64/wingman.app /Applications/ && grep -c "Option+Shift+9" /Applications/wingman.app/Contents/Resources/app/main.js && echo 'Installed to /Applications/wingman.app' && open /Applications/wingman.app
